instructions.question: What overall sentiment does the tweet's author express or convey about its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive covers enthusiasm, praise or celebration, plus upbeat promotion of entertainment, products or media, achievements and honours, and plans to attend concerts or fun events. Negative covers complaints, disappointment, anger or mockery, personal mishaps and annoyances, and any report of violence, attacks, injuries or criminal charges, even plainly worded. Neutral covers plain news without harm or achievement, analytical commentary on sports or politics, routine logistics, questions, mixed views, and light jokes about trivial things.

neutral.what: News with no harm or achievement, schedules, questions, analytical opinions on teams or politicians, mixed views, and joking gripes about trivial matters.
examples: Fake punt on 4th and 11? Wow, James Franklin can make some odd decisions. #PennState #Michigan #PSUvsMICH
Pretty Little Liars isn’t back on till January. What am I supposed to do with my Tuesday nights until then?
Kanye West is insane. He also may be a complete genius. But I still don't want him to be president. #VMAs #fb
neutral.cues: may, reportedly, will be, who is going, scores, rankings, rumors, debate
neutral.not_for: Violence, injuries or charges (negative); achievements or event hype (positive).

positive.what: Excitement, praise, love, hope or celebration. Also upbeat promotion of events, products or shows, achievements, nominations or rankings, and going to concerts or fun outings.
examples: Can't wait to see you tomorrow at The Roxy!
Annual season kick-off with FENNARIO - New England's tribute to the Grateful Dead - Saturday, Aug 29th - Doors at 8pm
In the car on our way to Milton Keynes to see the Foo Fighters tomorrow. #foofighters #miltonkeynes
positive.cues: can't wait, love, excited, great, good, interesting, nomination, 1st place, kick-off, giveaway, new, live coverage, !!
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise (negative); plain logistics or flat chores (neutral).

negative.what: Sadness, anger, frustration, disappointment, insults, mockery, personal mishaps and annoyances, and reports of violence, attacks, injuries, crashes or charges.
examples: still so sad I'm not going to Ed Sheeran the 25th :////
Day 2 stuck in the Taipei airport. Possibly going to LA to wait out the storm. Didn't think I'd make it to Cali for the 1st time this way
RT @user Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
negative.cues: sad, bored, tedious, stuck, lost, hate, worst, pathetic, wtf, :/, shot dead, attack, injured, charged
negative.not_for: Calm analysis of a team or politician, joking gripes about one's evening (neutral).
